run_f_gold: run f_gold to count substrings with matching first and last characters in a string
test_f_gold: test f_gold against the built-in test cases to verify substring counting correctness
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use a frequency map instead of the O(n squared) brute force approach
review_f_gold: review f_gold and understand how it counts substrings where first and last characters match
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which iterates all substring pairs and counts those with equal endpoints
